title: KPI spec v1
description: The key metrics of a school's books, pinned once. Every channel (the atm fold, hledger, DuckDB) computes the base aggregates (sum, count, distinct) from the ledger events as this file says; the derived ones (ratio, combine) are evaluated in one place, from the base values. Regexes are the POSIX extended subset all three engines share: literals, [..] classes, ^ $ ( ) | * + ? . and a backslash before a literal dot; no \d \w \s, no lookaround, no lazy quantifiers.

grain.description: The period of every value: a calendar month of the event's local date, YYYY-MM.

eventType.description: The event's type is one of these; absent: any.

account.description: A posting's account matches. For `sum` it selects the postings that are added up; for `count` and `distinct` the event needs one such posting.

label.description: The event's label `name` exists and matches.

from.description: What the dimension is read from: a posting's account, or an event label.

pattern.description: One capture group: its text is the dimension value, and the KPI's id becomes `<id>:<value>`. A value that does not match is left out.

unit.description: cents: USD minor units; count: whole numbers (members, events, credit units); ratio: a number between 0 and 1 and beyond, no unit.

precision.description: Decimal places the value is rounded to (half up, in integer arithmetic). Base aggregates are whole numbers: 0.

definition.description: The formula in words; the `compute` is the machine reading of it.

commodity.description: usd: USD postings, in cents; mrr: MRR postings (monthly recurring revenue), in whole cents a month; credits: every other commodity, in units.

sign.description: Multiplies the sum (income is a negative posting).

cumulative.description: The sum of every period up to and including this one (a closing balance).

first.description: Count a holder only in the first period it matches inside the periods asked for (a holder first seen before the window counts in the window's first period).

oneOf.description: Distinct holders (the event's `key`) in the period.
num / den of two KPIs without a dimension, in the same period; 0 when den is 0.
A signed sum of KPIs without a dimension.
